[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: Int) : Int :=
let a_unit := a % 10
let b_unit := b % 10
if a_unit = 0 ∨ b_unit = 0 then 0
else
  let product := a_unit * b_unit
  let result := product % 100
  if result % b_unit = 0 then result / b_unit * 10 else result
[END]
